name: Geared Up Apparel
old_description: “Not at all! We work with clients nationwide and offer reliable shipping anywhere in the U.S. Your custom order can be delivered directly to your door.”
about:
Geared Up Apparel operates from Elk River, Minnesota, as a family-driven, female-owned and operated small business. The company provides custom apparel and promotional products to clients nationwide, shipping anywhere in the United States.

The shop offers a range of decoration services including custom embroidery, screen printing, heat-seal printing, rhinestone and glitter application, and sublimated printing. It also sources promotional items such as jerseys, water bottles, stickers, pens, and chapstick. Digital mockups are provided for approval before production, and a one-time artwork fee applies for custom logo creation. The facility does not embroider leather or letterman jackets.

Geared Up Apparel serves small businesses, corporations, schools, athletic teams, associations, cities and counties, city services, and community members. Its embroidery work covers polos, dress shirts, jackets, hoodies, beanies, caps, medical scrubs, bags, joggers, and pants. The company also supports fundraising campaigns and local sponsorships.

The company emphasizes a clear, step-by-step process, relationship-based service, and fair pricing with exceptional value. Its stated mission is to create high-quality, fashionable custom apparel that fosters community and belonging, guided by values of creativity, integrity, and collaboration.
